downloadIntro.zh: 当前版本 v1.57.55，选择与你的电脑匹配的安装包。
downloadIntro.en: The current release is v1.57.55. Choose the installer that matches your computer.

summary.zh: 适用于常见的 Intel 与 AMD 电脑，提供标准安装程序。
summary.en: For common Intel and AMD PCs, delivered as a standard installer.

summary.zh: 适用于 Apple 芯片 Mac，以 DMG 磁盘映像安装。
summary.en: For Apple silicon Macs, delivered as a DMG disk image.

highlights.zh: 画图工具收藏：在画图菜单中点击星标收藏常用工具，收藏的工具显示在可拖动的收藏工具条上；左侧画图栏底部的星标按钮可显示或隐藏工具条。
highlights.en: Favorite drawing tools: star tools in the drawing menus to put them on a draggable favorites toolbar. The star at the bottom of the drawing toolbar shows or hides it.

highlights.zh: 指标收藏：指标菜单的每一项都可收藏，收藏的指标显示在菜单顶部。
highlights.en: Favorite indicators: star any indicator in the indicator menu to list it at the top.

highlights.zh: 工具条停靠：收藏工具条和画图属性栏可拖入图表标题栏，紧靠时区显示，不再遮挡 K 线；拖出即恢复浮动。
highlights.en: Docking: drag the favorites toolbar or the drawing properties bar into the chart header, beside the timezone, so it no longer covers the candles. Drag it out to float it again.

highlights.zh: 新画的图形沿用该工具上次设置的完整样式，包括填充颜色和透明度、中线、文字颜色等；「应用默认样式」会完整恢复出厂样式，套用画图模板不再覆盖图形上的文字。
highlights.en: New drawings start with the full look you last gave that tool, including fill colour and opacity, middle lines and text colour. Apply default style restores the full factory look, and applying a drawing template keeps the drawing's own text.

highlights.zh: Tick 存档的时间跳转可到达数据范围内的任意时间，不再局限于已加载的几周；跳转窗口显示实际可跳范围。
highlights.en: Time jumps in tick sessions reach any time in the data, not just the weeks already loaded, and the jump dialog shows the range you can actually reach.
